name: Cotanes del Monte (Spain)
description: Vertically divided white and red, the red charged with ten yellow discs arranged as a bunch of grapes.
history: The arms and municipal flag were approved by the full council of Cotanes del Monte in its session of 27 March 2001; the arms are party per pale, first argent a mount vert charged with a well argent masoned sable, second gules a bunch of grapes or, and the flag is rectangular, of proportions 2:3, formed of two equal vertical stripes.

features.role: ten discs arranged as an inverted triangle, like a bunch of grapes
